# Frozen Prose Loop

This document tests whether prose can change without rerunning computation.

Prose revision: changed without rerunning cached code.

## Mathematics

For independent samples $X_1, \ldots, X_n$, the sample mean is

$$
\bar{X}_n = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i.
$$

## Static figure

```{python}
#| label: static-figure
#| fig-cap: A deterministic convergence curve.
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sample_sizes = [10, 20, 50, 100, 200]
errors = [0.25, 0.16, 0.09, 0.06, 0.04]

fig, axis = plt.subplots()
axis.plot(sample_sizes, errors, marker="o")
axis.set(xlabel="samples", ylabel="absolute error")
plt.show()
```

## Interactive figure

```{python}
#| label: interactive-figure
import plotly.express as px

px.line(
    x=sample_sizes,
    y=errors,
    markers=True,
    labels={"x": "samples", "y": "absolute error"},
)
```
